label: Burger King UK Sanity CMS content API (project czqk28jt, dataset prod_bk_gb) — nutritionWithModifiers per menu item

samples.name: 6pc Pringles Sour Cream & Onion Chicken Fries

notes: burgerking.co.uk is a React SPA; HTML has no macros. Found Sanity project id czqk28jt in the og:image CDN URL in the page head, then probed dataset names -> prod_bk_gb. GROQ query over _type=="item" returns 452 items with calories, 419 with BOTH calories and proteins. Plausibility check protein*4 <= kcal*1.15 passed on all 419 rows (0 violations). Query is unauthenticated GET.
